correctness.rationale: The proof covers all quantified cases: disconnected initial coalitions can be split without changing utilities; small components must be intact; every connected run on a large path/cycle must fill the capacity by a weak-blocking one-vertex extension; full runs resist all possible strict-core deviations by a saturation propagation argument; and labeled small-component unions yield the restricted weighted Bell coefficient. The exact finite checker enumerated 570 distinct degree-two graph/capacity cases, 614381 admissible partitions, and checked all capacity-respecting deviations. Finite checks corroborate but do not substitute for the complete proof.

originality.rationale: The new contribution is the complete if-and-only-if divisibility criterion and all-partition weighted Bell census for strict-core stability under cardinality-limited, symmetric unweighted positive friendships on disjoint unions of paths and cycles. The nearest primary papers cover bounded-coalition hardness and a clique obstruction (arXiv:2306.01378), connected-communication hedonic games (Igarashi and Elkind 2016), and ordinary-core rather than strict-core existence (arXiv:2402.10815v1). Their statements do not logically force this exact classification. Searches of relevant published results and accessible earlier findings found no dominating theorem. Priority risk remains under alternative terminology and partially accessible literature.
residual_risks: An exact equivalent result may be published under alternative terms such as strong stability, weak blocking, limited-size friendship teams, or coalitional graph tilings.
Friends/enemies/neutrals literature was available only at abstract level for one relevant 2023 item; it was not used to certify noncoverage.
No external independent priority audit has been performed.

value.rationale: An exact infinite-family existence, construction and full enumeration theorem identifies the decisive divisibility invariant and its necessary group structure for a motivated capacity-bounded cooperative-game problem. The sparse path obstruction and k cyclic tiling phases are mathematically informative; the weighted Bell term tracks nontrivial possible mergers of small components. It is a complete classification, not a routine renamed numerical slice.
